title.en: Fertilization, pregnancy, birth and reproductive health

text.en: A single cell, the zygote, becomes a baby in about 280 days. This lesson follows that journey and then looks at how families can protect reproductive health.

Fertilization in humans is internal and takes place in the ampulla of the fallopian tube; the ovum lives about 24 hours, and the fused sperm and ovum form the zygote.
The zygote divides by cleavage, the first division about 30 hours after fertilization, forming a blastocyst of an outer layer and an inner cell mass.
Implantation is the attachment of the blastocyst to the uterine wall about 6 to 7 days after fertilization.
Gastrulation forms the three germ layers (ectoderm, mesoderm and endoderm) and organogenesis builds the organs from them.
The placenta is the temporary link between mother and embryo exchanging food, oxygen, wastes and carbon dioxide; the umbilical cord connects it to the foetus.
Gestation lasts about 280 days; at birth (parturition) oxytocin makes the uterus contract.
Lactation is milk production, stimulated by prolactin, with milk ejection by oxytocin; the first fluid, colostrum, carries immune substances.
Fraternal twins come from two eggs fertilised by two sperms; identical twins come from one egg that splits.
Reproductive health, per the WHO, is total well-being in all aspects of reproduction; India's Family Welfare and RCH programmes support it.
Contraception includes barrier methods (condom, diaphragm), hormonal pills, IUDs like Copper-T and surgical methods (vasectomy, tubectomy); the red triangle is the family planning symbol.

problem.en: A couple uses a condom. Give two ways it helps.

text.en: It acts as a barrier, so sperms cannot reach the ovum.
It also protects against sexually transmitted diseases such as syphilis and AIDS.
So it helps both family planning and health.

why.en: Hormonal methods and IUDs do not protect against infection.

prompt.en: Sequence the events from fertilization to birth.

requiredIdeas.en: Birth after about 280 days with oxytocin

points.en: Fertilization occurs in the fallopian tube; implantation about day 6-7.
Placenta exchanges food, oxygen and wastes; gestation lasts 280 days.
Oxytocin causes birth; prolactin makes milk.
Contraceptive methods: barrier, hormonal, IUD, surgical.
